semantic_state_alignment.reason: Honshu-Izu trait matching/functional-diversity coordinates are not the same biological measurements as Zurich guild-specific visitation rates.

response_alignment.reason: Standardized pollen receipt is not prospectively interchangeable with the Zurich fruit/seed count and proportion endpoints.

origin_independent_of_study_identity.reason: One archive per origin makes island/urban origin perfectly confounded with study, taxa, protocol and response construction.

genuine_cross_system_validation.reason: Within-system site/garden holdout exists, but no replicated origin permits origin-separated whole-system transfer validation.

permitted_narrower_claim: Upstream habitat/context scalars can become predictively redundant after measured partial process states in some island and urban systems; this does not establish a shared cross-origin dynamical law.
counter_boundary: Oenothera retains spatial-isolation information after pollinator treatment for contemporary mating state, so interaction state alone is not assumed complete.

minimum_identifiable_future_design.origin_replication: at least two independent systems per origin or one coordinated multi-origin protocol
models: F_future ~ S + origin + S:origin if prospectively declared
